record.rationale: Actual pinned SDK exception_ptr value operations are exposed through a neutral external/libcxx facade: empty/copy/guarded assignment/opaque equality/nonempty rethrow/destruction. Real CppuHelper composition installs the compiler ABI beside the existing getCaughtException/throwException bridge. Its actual generated Any/exception payload retains derived fields and Context until the final shared pointer releases it; ordinary host objects are VM-owned. Package source imports only the neutral standard-library contract, never browser implementation. Native addresses/C++ heap object identity/cross-realm atomics/TLS/fatal/OOM/nonobject JS throws remain unqualified. Actual background ZIP task/temp-file/error/entry transfer works in source explicit ThreadPool(0) and main/DOM-free Worker, without replacing production worker selection. Source ZipOutputEntry whole-owner branch coverage remains below90; prior failing gates remain retained. Full worker scheduler/parallel ZIP/package/Medium/filter/UI remain pending.
